title: TSV Tier-Cap Ladder
description: Replays a tokenized-stock venue's daily volume and symbol counts (aggregated across affiliated TSVs) against the SEC TSV Exemption tier caps and the condition F stepped-compliance ladder, and emits pause windows.

tsv_id.description: Non-empty identifier of the venue being replayed; its volume is always included in the aggregate.

affiliated_tsv_ids.description: Identifiers of affiliated TSVs whose volume and symbols aggregate with the venue's. Never repeats tsv_id.

stocks.description: Declared universe [{ symbol, tier, prior_month_adv_shares }]. Tier is caller-declared ('tier_1'|'tier_2'); no LULD lookup.

prior_month_adv_shares.description: Positive integer prior-month ADV in shares, caller-declared. null reports the stock INDETERMINATE — never assumed.

daily_volume.description: One row per venue per day per symbol [{ date, tsv_id, symbol, shares }]; rows for the group are summed. Duplicates refused.

shares.description: Non-negative integer share count for that venue, day and symbol.

symbols_traded.description: Optional distinct-symbol record [{ date, tsv_id, symbol }]. When omitted, symbol days are derived from daily_volume.

prior_breaches.description: Volume breaches already recorded before the replayed window [{ symbol, date }]. Consumes the stock's one-time first-breach pass.

as_of_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD date the pause status is evaluated as of.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads: tsv_id, affiliated_tsv_ids, stocks, daily_volume, symbols_traded, prior_breaches, as_of_date.
author: PostOakLabs

pause_windows.trigger: subsequent volume breach — the TSV must immediately pause trading in this Tokenized NMS Stock for three months, affiliated TSVs included (91 FR 60175 and fn. 75)
obligations: Immediately notify TSV Participants of the pause in trading through any regular means of communication (91 FR 60175-76).
Amend the TSV’s public Notice within five business days of the pause (91 FR 60175-76).

Volume ladder (91 FR 60175): after the first time a TSV exceeds the volume threshold in a given Tokenized NMS Stock, each subsequent exceedance requires the TSV to immediately pause trading in that stock for three months, and affiliated TSVs must accordingly pause trading in the same stock (fn. 75). The first exceedance itself required no action beyond not exceeding the thresholds going forward.

Pause record (91 FR 60175-76): each time the TSV has paused trading in a Tokenized NMS Stock in connection with the volume threshold — TSV-initiated or pursuant to the condition — it must immediately notify its TSV Participants through any regular means of communication and amend its public Notice within five business days.
assumptions: Reset-window assumption: the order states no reset or look-back window for the volume-breach ladder, so the node applies none — the first-breach pass is consumed once per stock across all supplied data (prior_breaches plus the replayed window) and is never restored (91 FR 60175).

Pause arithmetic assumption: a pause starts on the breach date and the stock may resume trading three calendar months from that date (91 FR 60175), with month-end clamping when the day does not exist (31 Jan + 3 months = 30 Apr); the resume date itself is a trading day (the window is [start, resume_date)).

Rounding statement (the only rounding): the daily volume cap in integer shares is floor(prior_month_adv_shares x 25/10000) for tier_1 and floor(prior_month_adv_shares x 250/10000) for tier_2 (91 FR 60174); a breach is volume strictly greater than the cap ("exceeds"). The floor is the conservative direction — it never inflates a cap.
Ordering assumption: where a prior breach and an in-window breach share a date, the prior breach is treated as the earlier one.

Breach-during-pause assumption: a breach date falling inside an existing pause window is still recorded and still triggers its own three-month pause from that date; the order does not address trading that should not have occurred during a pause, so the node records rather than judges it.

Exclusions: tiers and prior-month ADV are caller-declared — the node performs no LULD Plan lookup and no effective-transaction-reporting-plan lookup (91 FR 60174 defines the ADV denominator as reported by such a plan); a stock with no declared prior-month ADV is reported INDETERMINATE rather than given an assumed ADV; aggregation covers only the declared tsv_id and affiliated_tsv_ids; the node never looks up LULD trading halts. This is an evidence artifact only: it never states or implies that the venue is, or is not, compliant.
output_example.note: Evidence replay only: breaches, pause windows and the obligations the order states, computed over caller-supplied data. It never states that the venue is compliant.
